evals.prompt: /code_zl 私有struct依次float gain,uint8_t mode,bool ready,float limit,uint8_t retry,bool valid；另有packed协议struct固定offset。把同类放一起，顺便换函数形参顺序。只许注释整理。
evals.expected_behavior: Report interleaved private members for authorized structural code_wrt work, suggest separate float/uint8_t/bool groups preserving within-type order, but do not reorder any member in code_zl. Preserve packed fixed offsets as an exception and do not expand grouping to function parameters. Do not assert fixed RAM savings without target evidence or create nested structs/headers.

evals.prompt: /code_zl src/modbus.c src/host_comm.c
evals.expected_behavior: Should read both files, add standard function header comments (Name/Input/Output/Description), add // inline comments for key if/while/switch logic, and use short .c section comments like /* 静态函数声明 */ without equal-sign decoration. Must not use /* ==================== */ in .c. Report summary table at end.

evals.prompt: 整理我暂存的代码
evals.expected_behavior: Should first run git diff --cached --name-only to identify changed files, then only comment the changed parts (new functions get headers, new fields get inline comments). Should NOT touch unchanged old code.

evals.prompt: /code_zl inc/main.h
evals.expected_behavior: Should explain non-obvious macro/enum/field/API contracts once at their owner, align existing declarations and trailing comments using project style, and avoid repeating obvious facts. Must not reorder struct/enum members, rename APIs, or migrate ownership under a comments request.

evals.prompt: 给 can.c 添加注释，参照 docs/协议表.md
evals.expected_behavior: Should first read docs/协议表.md for protocol details, then add comments referencing protocol field meanings, register addresses, bit definitions. Comments should cite the protocol document path.

evals.prompt: /code_zl Application/driver/src/bsp_pwm.c
evals.expected_behavior: Init functions must use short /* 分节：配了什么 */ titles (clock, GPIO pins, timer base, complementary PWM, Break protection) plus only non-obvious trailing //. Must not annotate every DDL field, and must not write long principle paragraphs inside Init.

evals.prompt: /code_zl Application/driver/src/drv_device.c — 函数头里写了待上板验证
evals.expected_behavior: Must add // todo: markers on specific lines that need board test or follow-up confirmation (ASCII colon, one space after colon). Each todo must state what to verify and pass criteria. Must not leave 待确认 only in function header Description without line-level // todo:. Report todo count in summary table.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 这里宏是 750‰，旧注释写 Vguard=80%×Vidle，帮我润色一下
evals.expected_behavior: Must not beautify a contradiction. State that code is 75% while comment says 80%, correct only source-confirmed wording, and mark the product value for confirmation rather than guessing.

evals.prompt: /code_zl relay_closed 其实只是 GPIO ODR=1，没有辅助触点，注释写‘继电器已吸合’可以吗
evals.expected_behavior: Must rewrite to hardware truth: MCU relay command/ODR is high, not physical contact feedback. Do not imply a capability the board does not have.

evals.prompt: /code_zl SysTick 置一个 bool 1ms 标志，主循环消费，注释写‘每1ms精确执行一次控制’
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject the exact-timing claim. A bool flag can coalesce ticks; comment should describe flag consumption and note that deadline/tick-loss needs separate validation.

evals.prompt: /code_zl protection.c 的安全宏只靠多层 include 才看得见，给 #if 加句‘默认开启保护’就行
evals.expected_behavior: Must not hide a structural safety risk with comments. Flag transitive/possibly undefined macro visibility and hand the include/config fix to code_wrt/code_sc.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 给十几个只有一行调用的 wrapper 写详细函数头，让代码显得更规范
evals.expected_behavior: Must not legitimize over-fragmentation with verbose comments. Flag trivial wrappers for code_wrt review rather than creating or glorifying them.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 这段首拍 COMP2 保护已经过 source guard，注释直接写‘首拍绝对安全’
evals.expected_behavior: Must avoid unsupported safety claims. State the source-order guarantee and add a measurable board/scope todo for real hardware response latency if evidence is missing.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 把头文件分节整理一下，里面有产品共享参数、Output执行参数和Protection恢复参数
evals.expected_behavior: Must group comments by true owner/semantic domain, avoid vague ‘公共参数’, and not create more headers or move logic. If mixed ownership is structurally wrong, report it for code_wrt.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 只整理 a.c。f() 后有 #if BOARD_BUILD 下的 static uint32_t seen;，f() 内还有 static int calls;。main.h 的私有类型也顺手挪回 a.c，DRV_Stop 改 drv_stop 吧。
evals.expected_behavior: Keep comments-only scope: report type migration and API rename for code_wrt. Exclude function-local calls from file-scope layout check; never move seen across its original guard. Only move a file-scope declaration when same-scope/same-guard dependency equivalence is demonstrated; otherwise report it.

evals.prompt: /code_zl：static bool prepare(uint16_t duty) 总是true但会写零；bool zero_applied(void) 读更新事件；ADC_IRQHandler 一行转发。帮我注释并把短函数都删掉。
evals.expected_behavior: Explain that deletion/return-type changes are structural code_wrt work. Document prepare as issuing a request and zero_applied as later evidence, preserve IRQ bridge name and hardware timing barriers. Do not claim physical zero from prepare or delete by line count.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 函数实际为 static uint16_t duty_get(const sample_t *sample)，上面同时有 @brief 和 Name: duty_get(...)。同文件还有简单私有 clamp()。项目已有.clang-format，用户只允许改两个.c注释。
evals.expected_behavior: Use one contract header with exact static uint16_t duty_get(const sample_t *sample), correct Input/Output, and remove duplicate old header. Simple private clamp may omit a header. Do not change project format config or claim whole-scope style from merely preserving it; inspect both allowed files.

evals.prompt: /code_zl diag.integral_copy仅Host读取，core.integral参与下一拍积分，diag.duty由两种已授权遥测读取；旧注释说所有diag都是无用状态。Host上周通过，今天只改注释就写实板验证通过并升固件版。
evals.expected_behavior: Correct the comment using producer/consumer distinctions without deleting code: internal integral is necessary, authorized telemetry is real consumption, Host-only copy may be a structural cleanup candidate. Do not claim current Host or board PASS from old results; no firmware version bump for pure comments.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 注释写“启动期占空比上限”，但字段名是 demo_startup_duty_floor_permille，而且代码把有效上限顶到这个值。
evals.expected_behavior: Flag the floor-versus-upper-bound mismatch. Correct the comment to describe the startup floor/effective limit fact, or hand a name change to code_wrt. Do not claim a permanent final Duty cap.

evals.prompt: /code_zl calculate_ccm_boundary_duty_permille 的注释写“最终最大 Duty”，last_control_ms 注释写“最近一次真正积分”。
evals.expected_behavior: Correct the first comment to a theoretical CCM boundary and the second to the most recent control-timebase processing point, with actual integration determined by control_dt_ms. Do not change calculations.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 旧名只出现在 V0.16.1 历史学习稿，当前 Application 已全部迁移。
evals.expected_behavior: Classify the hit as an explicitly marked historical snapshot, do not restore old aliases or alter production code, and report that active-source old-name search is clean.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 给暂存区变更补中文逐行注释。同文件的未暂存变更把 target=0 从未启用改成停机。暂存版只有 cv_enabled=true 时 0 才否决。还要让新人从当前架构文档找到函数。
evals.expected_behavior: Read cached diff and indexed source separately from worktree. Cover all relevant function heads and per-line control logic, using names, units and actual validity/zero semantics. Do not write notes inconsistent with local code or overwrite overlapping changes, and leave index untouched. Sync authorized architecture entries with the matching source only.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 函数 preview 读写经指针传入的正式状态，缓存只按序号和最小值，shadow 错误会返回 0。本轮只加注释。旧注释说只读、同一采样复用、仅测试日志。
evals.expected_behavior: Show actual state writes, cache keys, and consumer of the shadow mismatch in clear Chinese. Report inaccurate names, missing key or hidden stop as review findings for code_sc/code_wrt. No new guard, macro removal, or fabricated read-only behavior.

evals.prompt: /code_zl 只补本次单语句 if 的注释，项目原样这样写，未授权格式配置。另一处涉及未实测的复位后引脚，应解释判据。
evals.expected_behavior: Keep C tokens and format config unchanged for comments-only work. Use scoped plain Chinese, and a generic observable todo at the relevant line only when needed. Never conclude hardware state from a driver or relay command alone. Preserve project brace policy if formatting is separately requested.
